messages:
Marta (Marketing): quick sync — Hypersight is ready to do a case study. Need interview (recorded), quote approvals, legal release, and inbound routing for the launch.
Diego (Sales): they agreed to a 25m recorded interview Wed 9am PT. Speaker = Head of ML (Lina). I'll confirm logo + PR contact.
Rohit (Customer Success): Lina prefers we avoid clinical examples and no raw logs. she'll share sanitized perf numbers.
Marta (Marketing): perfect. can we get two hero bullets? e.g., p95 latency down X% and token cost Y%?
Rohit (Customer Success): preliminary: p95 down ~45%, token cost ~32% after dedicated + caching. will send exact figures.
Ana (Growth): for webinar/reg form, Sales wants three qualifiers: company size, deployment intent (prod/PoC), and urgent contact? Map to HubSpot tags.
Diego (Sales): tagging: hyp-launch, intent_prod boolean. I'll handle owner mapping.
Marta (Marketing): draft quote for approval: "Hypersight cut inference latency by 45% and reduced per-token costs by 32% after moving to Redwood Dedicated and enabling KV prefix caching." Flag if Legal edit needed.
Priya (Legal): check this: (1) get signed marketing release (2) confirm no PHI or HIPAA risk (3) avoid absolute language if customer prefers approximate. I can review within 48h after release.
release-bot: Marketing release MR-8921 created. Status: awaiting customer signature.
Diego (Sales): sent MR-8921 to Lina. ETA for signature: same day as interview.
Marta (Marketing): timeline: interview Wed -> Legal signoff by Fri -> publish + webinar 1 week later. Aim for total turnaround <= 7 business days post-interview.
Ana (Growth): will set up Zapier -> HubSpot routing and a 3-step nurture: reminders, post-webinar case PDF, sales CTA.
Rohit (Customer Success): uploading perf spreadsheet now (sanitized).
Marta (Marketing): once we have signed release and numbers, I'll post 3 pull-quotes here for quick Legal + Customer sign-off. Thanks all :rocket:
